support_protocol.description: Canonical voltage clamp histories: alternating long hyperpolarization/recovery and brief repeated depolarizing bursts, randomized durations/amplitudes. No fresh evaluation traces are used to manufacture targets.

objective: Final2x2 diagnostic:128vs512tick current acceptance panel x additional128tick autonomousV/Ca acceptance panel. Same decaying step, initial52i combined weights,400attempts. All reserved fit panels excluded from gradient sampling in every arm.
selection: Unchanged original52d per-channel andV/Ca development guards and same validation objective/checkpoints. Initial warmstart retained as fallback; no reset of tolerances to a worse baseline.

diagnostics: Original channel/V/Ca eligibility per checkpoint; Ih error and regressions for all11channels; support x worst-guard contrasts and interaction. Same final imposed/autonomous, interventions and cost evaluation. No promotion by mean score.
limitations: Last52subtask, no52k. Reused data and warmstart, not independent confirmation.400attempts chosen because52i had no eligible600/800checkpoints. Fit acceptance cannot prove generalization. Proceed53after audit with unresolved limits explicit. Thresholds and10states unchanged.

preservation.reference: Frozen original52d trajectory, same fit windows and initial conditions; training-only reference, never an inference component.
preservation.formula: mean_channels relu((block_MSE-current_reference_block_MSE)/clamp(reference_block_MSE,1e-6)); block is128ticks and batch-averaged. No penalty for improving a channel.

projection.priority: current-objective gradient, including guard when enabled
projection.formula: For each independent seed/model: if dot(gc,gv)<0, gv <- gv-dot(gc,gv)/norm(gc)^2*gc; use gc+gv before the original per-model gradient clip and Adam.
projection.limitation: Euclidean first-order gradient protection is not a guarantee for finite Adam steps, individual channels, or autonomous rollouts. Test those explicitly.

targeted_Ih.description: Replace two of eight fit windows with existing slow_recovery fit histories, sampling preregistered onset/late hyperpolarization/recovery anchors. No development or fresh targets added. Same total batch and updates.
